card.name: Inside sugar-related words
card.fires_on: The ending of sugar-related words such as galactose or glucuronosyl, especially the final piece "ose" after "galact" in lactose-intolerance warnings. It also fires on a few other word endings like "dust" and "IN".

modes.label: Galactose intolerance warnings
modes.description: The final piece "ose" of galactose in warnings about rare hereditary galactose intolerance.
modes.example: rare hereditary problems of galact<<ose>> intolerance, the Lapp lactase deficiency

modes.label: Glucose and glucuronide names
modes.description: Middle pieces of glucose-related chemical names such as glucuronosyl.

modes.label: Other word endings
modes.description: Scattered endings of unrelated words, such as sawdust or a drug name in capitals.
modes.example: Carefully clean away any sawd<<ust>>, as this will also put them off
